$comment: Adi-editable scheduling inputs, read by src/schedule.mjs via tools/ready.mjs. exclude: post numbers dropped from the queue (mark, never delete; starts empty, Adi decides duplicates per out/audit/content.md). priority: save-magnet posts in ranked order; the first two publishable ones take the first two slots, then one lands roughly every third slot. Post 49 is a fixture and is not listed. nearDuplicates: pairs used ONLY for spacing (never within 12 slots, about 6 weeks); they do not remove anything. Changing this file never moves a date that is already assigned in state/schedule.json.
